writableState.name: photo library
writableState.rollback: Preserve the entire directory: SQLite metadata, private originals, rendered full-size images and thumbnails. Stop the API for a consistent filesystem backup; retain a pre-upgrade snapshot. Never restore an older database over newer uploads without explicit operator review.

writableState.name: logs
writableState.rollback: Preserve the journal; do not copy logs into a release archive.

privateConfiguration: Root-owned mode0600 /etc/kyapup/api.env supplies ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH and ALLOWED_ORIGINS; the service reads it through EnvironmentFile. No secrets, sessions, SQLite data or uploaded photos belong in source, static output or runtime archives.
topology: Static Nuxt output with one independent Express API, Node built-in SQLite and sharp/libvips. Direct Nginx/systemd deployment uses a loopback listener and persistent StateDirectory. kyapup.com and kyagirl.com serve the same application; preserve reviewed installed paths, ports, IPv4/IPv6 and TLS policy. Ephemeral function storage is not a supported photo-library deployment.
